## Description

A clear and concise description of what this PR changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality
      to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Chore (dependencies, tooling, CI, etc.)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes with no errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes (all tests green)
- [ ] New functionality includes tests
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) updated if relevant
- [ ] No unrelated changes mixed into this PR

## Testing

Describe how you tested your changes. Include commands and expected output.

```bash
npm test
# Test Files  18 passed (18)
# Tests       86 passed (86)
```

## Related issues

Closes # (issue number)

## Screenshots / examples

If applicable, add screenshots or example output to help explain your change.
